name: Frankfurt-Egelsbach Airport

runway.v: asphalt runway 08/26, 1,400 m x 25 m, plus a 670 m grass runway

hours.v: summer 06:00 UTC to end of civil evening twilight (08:00 local to dusk), winter 07:00 UTC to dusk (08:00 local); with PPR from 07:00 local and from dusk until 19:00 UTC summer / 20:00 UTC winter (21:00 local)

curfew.v: closed 21:00-07:00 local; 07:00-08:00 and dusk-21:00 local need PPR; night flights need PPR requested by 12:00 UTC (summer) or 13:00 UTC (winter)
curfew.quote: 0700 bis ECET*, 0600-0700 PPR, ECET* bis 2000 PPR, NACHTFLUG PPR bis 1300

customs.v: customs clearance during operating hours, including commercial goods; flights from non-Schengen countries must notify 48 hours ahead
customs.quote: Zollabfertigung Ja, während der Betriebszeiten; einschließlich Handelsware.

ppr.v: PPR for early morning, after dusk and night flights; requests online any time; jet, turboprop and class B/C piston pilots must complete an online briefing
ppr.quote: PPR Requests can be flexibly lodged anytime online.

permits.v: non-Schengen flights: border clearance notice 48 hours in advance

handling.v: as a rule all aircraft handling is done by the airport operator; other providers need prior permission
handling.quote: As a general rule, all aircraft handling is performed by the airport operator.

fuel.v: aircraft may only be refuelled with the fuels offered by the airport operator
fuel.quote: Aircraft must only be refuelled using the aviation fuels offered by the airport operator.

notes: Read: the operator's Flugplatzbenutzungsordnung in force 25 Nov 2025 (German v1.2; English version also read, its cover still says valid from 01/02/2024) and the operator's Pilot Info page (modified 30 Oct 2026). DFS AIP not read. Times in the rules are UTC; local times derived (CEST/CET). Short runway (1.4 km): light and some midsize jets only; the rules also limit wingspan on parts of the taxiways and aprons (18 m on part of taxiway C).
